load in libraries
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(stringr)
library(lmerTest)
library(broom.mixed)
```

load in crypt metadata and atrributions 
```{r}
crypt_metadata<-read.csv('../Data/biopsy_metadata.csv')
crypt_signature_attributions<-read.csv('../Data/crypt_signature_attributions.csv')
```

# 1. Rates of background mutagenesis in children’s colonic epithelium

## a : create a dataframe for analysing rates of background mutations
```{r}
## annotate biopsies and patients :
crypt_signature_attributions<-left_join(crypt_signature_attributions, crypt_metadata,by=c('patient','biopsy'))%>%
  # adjust SBS and ID burdens for sensitivity derived from coverage and median vaf :  
  mutate(across(starts_with('SBS'),~as.numeric(.x) /sensitivitySBS),
         snv_muts=as.numeric(snv_total_burden)/sensitivitySBS,
         indel_muts=as.numeric(indel_total_burden)/sensitivityID,
  
         SBSBackground=SBS1+SBS5+SBS18)  # calculate background SBS mutations

## create dataframe for assessing those individuals who are colibactin negative, SBSB89/ID25 neg and histologically normal
background_df<-crypt_signature_attributions %>%
  filter(cohort!='IBD'&colonoscopy_finding != 'FAP' & biopsy_SBS89_ID25_pos==FALSE &patient_colibactin_pos==FALSE) 
```

```{r}
length(unique(background_df$patient))
```
## b : analysis of rates of snvs
### i : model for rate of sbs background mutations
first perform linear mixed effects modelling for just age and then age:location.
age:location is used because we want to determine different slopes for each location.
```{r}
# construct models 
age_only_lmer_ml<-lmer(SBSBackground ~ age+ (1 | patient),data = background_df)
age_location_lmer_ml<-lmer(SBSBackground ~ age:location+ (1 | patient),data = background_df) 
```

We first assess AIC to see if including location improves model :
```{r}
# assess AIC and anova for if including location if improves model :
AIC(age_only_lmer_ml,age_location_lmer_ml) # AIC better when incorporate location 
```
Then test assess anova to see if model significantly better with location.
The output from the below chunk indicates that deriving slopes for different locations
improves model fit.
```{r}
anova(age_only_lmer_ml,age_location_lmer_ml) # p-value<0.001
```
### ii : create summary outputs :
```{r}
## create summary outputs
# extract confidence intervals
sbs_conf <- as.data.frame(confint(age_location_lmer_ml)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("location") %>%
  rename(
    lower_ci = `2.5 %`,
    upper_ci = `97.5 %`
  )

# extract model coefficients and combine with confidence intervals
sbs_summary <- tidy(age_location_lmer_ml, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  filter(str_detect(term, "age:location")) %>%
  mutate(location = str_remove(term, "age:location"),
    mut_type = "SBS",
    across(c(estimate, conf.low, conf.high), round, 0),
    text = paste0(estimate, " mutations/year [", conf.low, ", ", conf.high, "]")
  ) %>%
  select(
    mut_type,
    location,
    Estimate = estimate,
    lower_ci = conf.low,
    upper_ci = conf.high,
    text
  )
# Store intercept value
sbs_summary$intercept <- round(summary(age_location_lmer_ml)$coefficients['(Intercept)','Estimate'],0)

# print model outptus
print(sbs_summary)
```
### iii : plot rates of sbs background mutations
Create a dataframe for biopsy level summary of background burdens
```{r}
## create df for biopsy level summary :
sbs_biopsy_sum <- background_df %>%
  group_by(biopsy) %>%
  summarise(
    SBSBackground_median = median(SBSBackground, na.rm = TRUE),
    SBSBackground_lwr    = quantile(SBSBackground, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    SBSBackground_upr    = quantile(SBSBackground, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    age       = median(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    location  = first(location),
    cohort    = min(cohort),
    site      = first(site),
    crypts    = n(),
    biopsy_SBS89_ID25_pos = first(biopsy_SBS89_ID25_pos),
    patient_colibactin_pos = as.factor(max(patient_colibactin_pos)),
    patient   = min(patient),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    location = factor(location, levels = c("Ascending", "Transverse", "Sigmoid")),
    rate = SBSBackground_median / age)
```

```{r}
## create a df for regression lines
line_df <- data.frame(
  location = sbs_summary$location,
  intercept = sbs_summary$intercept,
  slope_upper_ci = sbs_summary$upper_ci,
  slope = sbs_summary$Estimate,
  slope_low_ci = sbs_summary$lower_ci
  )

age_grid <- seq(0, 20, length.out = 200)
line_df_expanded <- line_df %>%
  group_by(location) %>%
  tidyr::crossing(age = age_grid) %>%
  mutate(
    fit = intercept + slope * age
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
line_df_expanded$location=factor(line_df_expanded$location,levels=c('Ascending','Transverse','Sigmoid'))

## create a datafraem for labels:
label_df <- data.frame(
  location = sbs_summary$location,
  label = c(paste0('SBS Background ~ ',sbs_summary$Estimate, " * age")),
  x = Inf,
  y = 0
)
label_df$location=factor(label_df$location,levels=c('Ascending','Transverse','Sigmoid'))
```

Construct plot for SBS background rates 
```{r}
svg('~/sbs_rates.svg',width=12,height=8)
ggplot(sbs_biopsy_sum,aes(x = age, y = SBSBackground_median, colour = location)) +
  
  # create points and errorbars for each biopsy
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = SBSBackground_lwr, ymax = SBSBackground_upr),width = 0,colour = "black") +
  geom_point(size=6) +
  
  # create slopes for each location
  geom_line(data = line_df_expanded,aes(x = age, y = fit,col=location),size=1,linetype = "dashed") +
  
  ## include text for rates for each location :
  geom_text(data = label_df[label_df$location=='Ascending',], aes(x = 0, y = 1500, label = paste0(location, ' Colon ', label)), 
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 5,colour = "black") +
  geom_text(data = label_df[label_df$location=='Transverse',], aes(x = 0, y = 1500, label = paste0(location, ' Colon ', label)), 
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, vjust = 3, size = 5,colour = "black") +
  geom_text(data = label_df[label_df$location=='Sigmoid',], aes(x = 0, y = 1500, label = paste0(location, ' Colon ', label)), 
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, vjust = 5, size = 5,colour = "black") +
  
  # stipule scales for colour, x and y :
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Ascending ='#84a9c6ff', Transverse ='goldenrod3',Sigmoid ='palevioletred4')) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 20)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-100,1500))+
  
  # state x and y axis labels
  labs(x = "Donor Age at Biopsy [years]", y = "Background SBS Mutations") +
  
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 15, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.9, "cm"),
    panel.spacing.y = unit(0, "cm"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))
dev.off()
```

## b : analysis of rates of indels
### i : model for rate of all background mutations
```{r}
## create models for indel rates
indel_age_only_lmer_ml<-lmer(indel_muts ~ age + (1| patient), data=background_df)
indel_age_location_lmer_ml<-lmer(indel_muts ~ age:location + (1| patient), data=background_df)
```

Once again assess AIC and anova :
AIC and anova once again illustrate that including location will improve the fit
of this model (anova p-value< 0.001)
```{r}
AIC(indel_age_only_lmer_ml,indel_age_location_lmer_ml)
```
```{r}
anova(indel_age_only_lmer_ml,indel_age_location_lmer_ml)
```

### ii : model for rate of all SBS Background mutations
```{r}
## construct summary dataframe 
id_conf<-as.data.frame(confint(indel_age_location_lmer_ml))%>%
  rownames_to_column(var='location')%>%
  rename(
    lower_ci = `2.5 %`,
    upper_ci = `97.5 %`
  )

id_summary<-tidy(indel_age_location_lmer_ml, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  filter(str_detect(term, "age:location")) %>%
  mutate(location = str_remove(term, "age:location"),
    mut_type = "ID",
    across(c(estimate, conf.low, conf.high), round, 1),
    text = paste0(estimate, " mutations/year [", conf.low, ", ", conf.high, "]")
  ) %>%
  select(
    mut_type,
    location,
    Estimate = estimate,
    lower_ci = conf.low,
    upper_ci = conf.high,
    text
  )
# Store intercept value
id_summary$intercept <- round(summary(indel_age_location_lmer_ml)$coefficients['(Intercept)','Estimate'],0)

print(id_summary)
```

### iii : plot the rates of background mutations
first create a dataframe for plotting
```{r}
## create df for patient level summary :
id_biopsy_sum<-background_df%>%
```

## c : compare the burden between cohorts:
### i : compare burdens of sbs between cohorts 
first create a dataframe for colibactin and SBS89/ID25 negative crypts
```{r}
# create dataframe for cohort comparisosn
compare_cohort_df <- crypt_signature_attributions %>%
  filter(biopsy_SBS89_ID25_pos==FALSE &patient_colibactin_pos==FALSE)%>%
  mutate(SBSBackground=SBS1 + SBS5 + SBS18)
```

```{r}
# construct models
age_location_ibd_included_lmer_ml<-lmer(SBSBackground ~ age:location+ (1 | patient),data = compare_cohort_df)
age_location_cohort_lmer_ml<-lmer(SBSBackground ~ age:location+cohort+ (1 | patient),data = compare_cohort_df)
```

Compare models to test if including cohort improves prediction of background burden
```{r}
anova(age_location_cohort_lmer_ml,age_location_ibd_included_lmer_ml) 
```

create a summary of the model output :
```{r}
# extract confidence intervals :
cohort_comparison_conf_int<-as.data.frame(confint(age_location_cohort_lmer_ml))%>%
  rownames_to_column(var='variable')%>%
   rename(
    lower_ci = `2.5 %`,
    upper_ci = `97.5 %`
  )

# format into a readable dataframe:
cohort_comparison_summary<-data.frame(summary(age_location_cohort_lmer_ml)$coefficients)%>%
  rownames_to_column(var='variable')%>%
  left_join(cohort_comparison_conf_int, by='variable')%>%
  mutate(across(c('Estimate','lower_ci','upper_ci'), ~round(.x,digits= 0)),
         `Pr...t..`=round(`Pr...t..`,digits=3),
         text=paste0(Estimate, ' mutations [', lower_ci,', ',upper_ci,']'))%>%
  select(variable,
         Estimate,
         pvalue=`Pr...t..`, 
         text)
```

print model outputs
```{r}
print(cohort_comparison_summary) # Estimate : -193 mutations [-310, -76] - indicates lower in Normal
```
### ii : test each background signature
```{r}
## test each signature :
sig_models <- list(
  SBS1 = summary(lmer(SBS1 ~ age:location + cohort + (1 | patient), data = compare_cohort_df)),
  SBS5 = summary(lmer(SBS5 ~ age:location + cohort + (1 | patient), data = compare_cohort_df)),
  SBS18 = summary(lmer(SBS18 ~ age:location + cohort + (1 | patient), data = compare_cohort_df))
)

for (signature in names(sig_models)) {
  ml <- sig_models[[signature]]
  
  coef <- data.frame(ml$coefficients)
  estimate=round(abs(coef['cohortNormal','Estimate']),digits=0)
  upper_ci <- abs(round(coef['cohortNormal','Estimate'] - 1.96 * coef['cohortNormal','Std..Error'], digits = 0)) # upper_ci and signs (-) flipped to create absolute because Normal lower rate
  lower_ci <- abs(round(coef['cohortNormal','Estimate'] + 1.96 * coef['cohortNormal','Std..Error'], digits = 0))
  pvalue <- round(coef['cohortNormal','Pr...t..'],digits=3)

  print(paste0(signature, ": ", estimate, " mutations [", lower_ci, ",", upper_ci, "] p-value=", pvalue))
}
```

### iii : compare burdens of id between cohorts 
```{r}
## test for effect of IBD on indels :
indel_age_location_cohort_lmer_ml<-lmer(indel_muts ~ age:location+cohort+ (1 | patient),data = compare_cohort_df)
```

create a summary dataframe for effect of IBD on indel
```{r}
id_ibd_conf<-data.frame(confint(indel_age_location_cohort_lmer_ml))%>%
  rownames_to_column(var='variable')
colnames(id_ibd_conf)<-c('variable','lower_ci','upper_ci')

id_ibd_summary<-data.frame(summary(indel_age_location_cohort_lmer_ml)$coefficients)%>%
  rownames_to_column(var='variable')%>%
  left_join(id_ibd_conf, by='variable')%>%
  mutate(across(c('Estimate','lower_ci','upper_ci'), ~abs(round(.x,digits= 1))))%>%
  mutate(text=paste0(Estimate, ' mutations/year [', lower_ci,', ',upper_ci,']'))%>%
  dplyr::select(variable,Estimate,`Pr...t..`, text,)

```

print the summary dataframe
```{r}
print(id_ibd_summary)
```


```{r}
  filter(!duplicated(paste0(chromosome1, start1,start2,patient)))%>%
  filter(patient=='PD65118')%>%
  nrow()
```

test association with colibactin presence
```{r}
# create dataframe for testing enrichment in colibactin positivie individuals :
test_sv_enrichment_df<-structural_variant_df%>%
  count(crypt,name='structural_variants')%>%
  left_join(crypt_signature_attributions,.,by=c('crypt'))%>%
  left_join(crypt_metadata,by=c('biopsy','patient'))%>%
  mutate(structural_variants=replace_na(structural_variants,0))

# test for enrichment :
test_sv_enrichment=summary(lmer(structural_variants~patient_colibactin_pos + age + (1|patient),data=test_sv_enrichment_df))
estimate=round(test_sv_enrichment$coefficients['patient_colibactin_posTRUE','Estimate'],2)
lower_ci=round(test_sv_enrichment$coefficients['patient_colibactin_posTRUE','Estimate']-1.96*test_sv_enrichment$coefficients['patient_colibactin_posTRUE','Std. Error'],2)
upper_ci=round(test_sv_enrichment$coefficients['patient_colibactin_posTRUE','Estimate']+1.96*test_sv_enrichment$coefficients['patient_colibactin_posTRUE','Std. Error'],2)

# print the outputs :
print(paste0('Estimate :', estimate, ' [',lower_ci,', ', upper_ci,']'))
```
